title: With all eyes on delimitation & FCRA, monsoon session sinks deeper into deadlock
content: Parliament has hit yet another impasse as the opposition protests continue for the thirteenth day. Despite this, the government succeeded in passing important legislation, including the Bankers' Books Evidence Bill and a bill concerning Supreme Court judges. In an effort to resolve the deadlock, minister Kiren Rijiju met with opposition figures, while Prime Minister Modi focused on discussing strategies with BJP Members of Parliament.

title: World C'ships: Shetty to face top-ranked Shi Yuqi in opener - full draw
content: Ayush Shetty will get the chance to improve his win-loss record against top-ranked Chinese shuttler Shi Yuqi in the first round of the 2026 BWF World Championships in New Delhi that begin on August 17. PV Sindhu, chasing her sixth medal, could face top seed and nemesis An Se Young only in the semi-final.

title: Black Sea attack: Merchant Navy officer's family refuses cremation, seeks martyr status
content: Following a brutal attack in the Black Sea, the remains of Merchant Navy chief officer Sagar Gupta were brought back to Kanpur. His family, deeply affected by the loss, has declared they will not conduct any last rites until specific demands are fulfilled, including martyr recognition, financial compensation, and employment for his widow.

title: OpenAI's Greg Brockman gives millions to save eagles Jackie and Shadow's home
content: Greg Brockman and his wife Anna donated five point five million dollars to save shoreline forest.  This significant contribution helped secure ten million dollars for land conservation efforts.  The land, which is home to rare species, will now be protected from development.  Over twenty-five thousand small donors also contributed to the successful fundraising campaign.  Meanwhile, the eagle matriarch Jackie faces an uncertain health prognosis.

title: Trump's immigration crackdown hits US military families; over 50 spouses detained
content: Dozens of parents and spouses of US service members face detention and deportation. This marks a significant shift from prior bipartisan immigration policies for military families. Many are detained during routine immigration status adjustment appointments. The Department of Homeland Security states military service does not exempt violations of immigration laws. These detentions negatively impact military readiness and family stability.

title: FIFA 'blackmailing' members to back Infantino, alleges former vice president
content: Prince Ali, who heads the Jordan Football Association, said the federation has still not received the prize money for finishing runners-up in the FIFA Arab Cup held in Qatar last December

title: Why US cities are deactivating Flock Safety cameras and canceling contracts
content: Cities across America are deactivating Flock's automated license plate reader cameras. Residents are damaging these devices amid widespread privacy concerns and data collection fears. Reports of law enforcement misuse have further fueled opposition to the surveillance technology. Flock maintains its cameras balance public safety and individual privacy rights. The company has implemented new audit processes to monitor technology usage.

title: Hyderabad CA dies by suicide by inhaling helium over 'gaming losses'
content: In Siddipet, a chartered accountant tragically took his own life, burdened by heavy gambling losses. Employing helium gas, a method learned from online tutorials, he was discovered in a hotel room after the staff notified the authorities. His suicide note revealed the anguish linked to his financial plight, despite family support and efforts to sell his property.

title: Meet Seungah Chung, who used 200 ants to reveal how they navigate
content: A bright young student embarked on a fascinating ant navigation experiment fueled by her natural curiosity. Through her meticulous research, she uncovered that ants primarily depend on visual markers for navigation. This groundbreaking project garnered her acclaim at a well-regarded science competition, showcasing the potential of such findings to inspire the development of innovative robots and autonomous systems.

title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
content: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

title: Commercial plane takes off as Trump’s helicopter nears airport; FAA investigates
content: An investigation by the Federal Aviation Administration has been initiated concerning a potential safety breach. A commercial aircraft took off just as President Trump’s helicopter was nearing Reagan National Airport, leading to a brief loss of separation. Following a tragic midair collision in 2025, stricter regulations have been enforced. The White House assured that the President’s safety was never compromised.

title: How Cristiano Ronaldo overcame poverty and loss to become a football legend
content: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey is about much more than football. From growing up in poverty and leaving home at 12 to losing his father before achieving global success, every challenge shaped the player he became. His story reminds people that discipline, sacrifice and love for family can help overcome even the hardest moments and turn dreams into reality.

title: How Travis Kelce is transforming lives beyond football in Kansas City
content: Kansas City Chiefs star Travis Kelce supports local children and families. He partnered with Kodiak to provide twenty-five thousand hot meals. Kelce also invested in Operation Breakthrough, a Kansas City nonprofit. His Eighty-Seven & Running Foundation supports youth programs and career exploration. This initiative offers practical skills and a safe space for students.

title: Meet Brock Lesnar's family: Wife Sable, children, parents and siblings
content: Brock Lesnar, the WWE legend, leads a private family life with his wife Sable.  They share two sons, Turk and Duke, who play competitive hockey.  Lesnar also has twins, Mya and Luke, from a previous relationship.  Mya excels in college shot put while Luke wrestles competitively.  Raised on a South Dakota dairy farm, Lesnar credits his parents for his strong work ethic.

title: Inside Marilyn Monroe's California home where the Hollywood icon spent her final days
content: Marilyn Monroe's former Los Angeles home, a Spanish-style residence, remains a significant cultural landmark today.  The property was acquired by new owners with plans for demolition in 2023.  However, the L.A. City Council designated the house a Historic Cultural Monument, halting demolition.  The owners then sued the city, claiming an unconstitutional taking of their private property.  A court dismissed the case, but the owners reportedly amended their complaint.

title: 'I worked tirelessly while staying in Pakistan': Nadeem blames cold for CWG poor show
content: Pakistan’s Olympic javelin champion Arshad Nadeem blamed Glasgow’s cold weather for his ninth-place Commonwealth Games finish, saying it stiffened his body and affected his run-up. Despite the setback, he urged fans not to lose faith and promised a strong comeback. Nadeem’s next challenge is the Lausanne Diamond League on August 21, where he will face Neeraj Chopra.

title: Cong vs Cong in Punjab: With 'sleeper cell' warning, party puts Channi camp on notice
content: Amid rising infighting, the Congress party has issued a stern warning to Punjab's dissenters regarding their involvement with internal 'sleeper cells.' Amarinder Singh Raja Warring, the state president, has promised that party members acting against Congress will face consequences, with no tickets granted to them. The situation intensifies as Charanjit Singh Channi's supporters openly question the leadership, complicating the party's position in the face of a multi-dimensional electoral challenge in assembly elections early next year.

title: Indian-American Congressman Shri Thanedar loses Democratic primary in Michigan
content: Shri Thanedar lost the Michigan Democratic primary to Donavan McKinney. McKinney secured victory with support from the party's progressive wing. Thanedar acknowledged the socialist movement's influence on the election outcome. His defeat may reduce Indian-American representation in the House. Thanedar expressed gratitude for his service and plans to remain active.

title: Suspected sulphur dioxide leak kills 3 factory workers in Karnataka's Yadgir
content: A catastrophic event unfolded in Yadgir district early Wednesday as a suspected sulphur dioxide leak claimed the lives of three workers and left two others injured. Reports suggest that the chemical leak caused suffocation among the employees present. The victims were migrant laborers hailing from Telangana and Madhya Pradesh, and the survivors are now under medical care at a nearby hospital.

title: R Madhavan says he has no political ambitions, calls CM Vijay a dear friend
content: Actor R Madhavan shared his joy for his friend Vijay, now in the Chief Minister's role, while firmly stating that he has no ambitions in politics. He described politics as a complicated affair and expressed no desire to take on such responsibilities. Additionally, Madhavan talked about his role in 'GDN,' where he will portray inventor G. D.

title: Rupee hits 1-month closing high despite RBI pause; sliding oil prices help
content: The currency opened 0.5% stronger at 94.92 against the US dollar, its highest level since July 1. It later gave up nearly half of its early advance to settle at 95.1175 per dollar, its strongest closing level since July 7.

title: Lock Upp 2 Grand Finale: Shreya Kalra wins by 7 votes, bags Rs 1 crore
content: Shreya Kalra has triumphed in the electrifying finale of Lock Upp 2, being crowned the champion along with a lucrative cash prize of one crore rupees. Shivangi Joshi finished as the first runner-up in a nail-biting race where only seven votes distinguished the two finalists. As the news broke, fans expressed a spectrum of emotions, praising Kalra's accomplishment while showing admiration for Joshi's remarkable journey in the competition.

title: ‘Who brought 12-yr-old to protest site?’: POCSO action sought against CJP’s Dipke, Das
content: Advocate Rinki Chatterjee Singh filed a complaint seeking a Zero FIR against CJP leaders.  She questioned the presence of a 12-year-old child at a recent protest.  The advocate alleged organizers involved minors in the demonstration against the NEET paper leak.  Singh also raised concerns about the funding sources for the CJP protests.  Her complaint seeks action under the POCSO Act and Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

title: India's clean-energy challenge is no longer generation, but adoption: Experts
content: India has built significant renewable energy capacity and now needs integration. Experts highlight transmission and storage as key hurdles for clean energy use. The nation requires substantial energy storage capacity by 2030 for grid stability. Implementation and adoption of clean energy technologies are now the priority. Better policy, finance, and technology alignment will advance India's clean energy transition.

title: 'No ambulances, no coordination': Family alleges lapses after Air India turbulence scare
content: Palak Raniwala, daughter of the passenger injured on the Air India flight AI2379 operating from Phuket to Delhi after it faced sudden loss of altitude during cruise, recounted the harrowing experience, saying that the turbulence was so severe that it caused passengers, including her father, to touch the ceiling of the aircraft.

title: 'I wasted my best years': Ankur Warikoo's advice to a 35-year-old
content: Entrepreneur and content creator Ankur Warikoo has sparked a conversation on resilience after sharing his response to a 35-year-old professional facing a career setback. Through practical advice on taking responsibility, learning consistently and focusing on small, actionable steps, Warikoo underscores that rebuilding a meaningful life begins with changing one's mindset, not dwelling on past mistakes.

title: 'Don't use students for politics': BJP attacks Rahul over Jantar Mantar protest claims
content: The Bharatiya Janata Party has rejected Rahul Gandhi's allegations of police excesses.  BJP spokesperson Sambit Patra stated no bullets were fired during the protest.  He accused Gandhi of spreading a false narrative and using students politically.  Patra also questioned Gandhi's selective focus on certain student groups.  The party maintained that ministers attend Parliament when their departments are discussed.

title: RBI holds repo rate: Housing market eyes stronger festive housing demand
content: The Reserve Bank of India has maintained its benchmark repo rate at 5.25 percent, a move likely to foster buyer confidence and stimulate housing demand. Experts believe this steady rate will promote home purchases and encourage investments in real estate. The construction sector and related industries are expected to thrive with predictable borrowing costs, especially during the festive season.

title: Who is Tewolde Gebremariam? All you need to know about Air India’s new CEO
content: Tewolde Gebremariam takes over from Campbell Wilson, the New Zealander and former Singapore Airlines executive who was appointed in 2022 to lead Air India's transformation. Air India had earlier disclosed that Wilson had informed Chairman N Chandrasekaran in 2024 of his intention to step down during 2026.

title: After Pakistan boxer, Uganda athletes go ‘missing’ in Glasgow after CWG
content: Scottish police are probing reports of athletes from Pakistan and Uganda going missing after the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. Four Ugandan boxers reportedly disappeared, with one seeking asylum, while Pakistani boxer Qudratullah was also reported missing. Pakistan finished with just one medal, a bronze for Fatima Zahra, marking its poorest Commonwealth Games campaign in decades.

title: Nearly 2,000 RSS volunteers assist over 40,000 flood-affected families in Assam
content: Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh volunteers aided over forty thousand families in Assam's flood-hit regions. They provided rescue, food, and essential supplies to affected villagers in three districts. Medical camps were organized by the organization in collaboration with the National Medicos Organization. Volunteers also assisted with post-flood rehabilitation, including cleaning and agricultural support. These efforts focused on helping communities recover after the recent devastating floods.

title: Brock Lesnar retires: WWE legend shares official statement and future plans
content: Brock Lesnar has hung up his wrestling boots after a climactic showdown at SummerSlam 2026, where he was defeated by Oba Femi in the main event. In a reflective interview afterward, he revealed his intention to focus on family life and pursue recreational hunting. Lesnar showed immense appreciation for his fans, acknowledging their integral role in his journey through the wrestling world.

title: Delhi cop loses Rs 6 lakh in gaming, scripts ATM thefts to recover losses
content: After incurring heavy losses in online gaming, a Delhi Police constable turned to ATM theft as a solution. He gathered a team and taught them criminal tactics through internet videos. Their efforts led to the theft of more than twelve lakh rupees from two ATMs in Faridabad. However, the constable was left empty-handed when his gang refused to share the loot.

title: Bihar Governor appoints Upendra Kushwaha’s son Deepak Prakash as MLC
content: BJP MLC Devesh Kumar resigned after the Supreme Court asked the Bihar government how Prakash could remain an unelected Minister even after six months in office

title: Meghalaya launches mission to protect clouded leopards
content: India supports one of the most important remaining populations of the feline, which is Meghalaya’s State animal

title: DGMA warns of cyber threats as ports automate operations
content: Dependence of ports on interconnected systems has created new vulnerabilities that can adversely affect the safety, security and functioning of port facilities, DGMA said in an advisory

title: Top official reviews Independence Day arrangements at Parade Grounds in Amaravati
content: Emphasising inter-departmental coordination, Syamala Rao says that all agencies should work in close coordination to ensure smooth and successful conduct of the celebrations

title: Mark Zuckerberg sends apologies for ‘errors in operating the platform’, government sources say
content: “I apologised to the Minister on behalf of Meta for the error restricting PM Modi’s post,” Meta’s global head of public policy Joel Kaplan said in a statement shared by a Meta spokesperson.

title: IBM Consulting FutureNow Centre now in Visakhapatnam
content: IT and HRD Minister Nara Lokesh inaugurates the new facility that delivers high-end consulting and technology services to international clients

title: Amit Shah responsible for action against students, lacks courage to answer in Parliament: Rahul Gandhi
content: The Leader of the Opposition hails students for speaking publicly despite facing harassment, says they had shown greater courage than the country’s top leadership by standing before the media

title: Parliament clears Bill to increase number of judges in Supreme Court
content: Opposition members walked out before the voting on the Bill; will pendency in SC cleared because of appointment of four judges, asks Congress MP and senior lawyer Vivek Tankha

title: Jharkhand SIR: Over 43 lakh voters deleted in draft electoral rolls
content: Over 7 lakh dead, over 14 lakh untraceable, and over 15 lakh permanently shifted voters were recorded; around 1.16 lakh voters refused to sign the enumeration form; claims and objections phase from August 5 to September 4

title: Centre issues LoIs for 11 new flying training schools; annual pilot training capacity to increase by 750 cadets
content: With the addition of these 11 FTOs, India’s annual pilot training capacity is expected to increase by 750 cadets, providing a significant boost to the domestic training ecosystem

title: Aero India to be back in Bengaluru in February, 2027
content: The first three days of Aero India are dedicated to business visitors while the event is open to the general public on the last two days

title: Rain eases, normalcy returns in Ernakulam
content: Water levels in the Muvattupuzha, Thodupuzha and Kaliyar rivers remain below warning levels; affected areas witness no major rain-related trouble

title: Learn from senior MPs, stay clear of ‘Delhi intrigues’: PM to new NDA RS MPs
content: Modi also instructs the MPs to guard against the misuse of their letterhead and avoid being rude to people over phone

title: ED’s search and seizure operations are not independent ‘civil actions’: Karnataka High Court
content: The jurisdiction of the ED is inextricably intertwined with criminality. Attachment of property is merely an instrumentality employed in aid of prosecuting the offence of money laundering. It cannot, therefore, be artificially divorced from the criminal proceedings that give it life: High Court

title: RSS aims at weakening Left movement, says Vijayaraghavan
content: RSS’s influence is adversely affecting the country’s governance, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi showing undue haste in implementing its agenda in areas including history, higher education and literature, says the CPI(M) leader

title: Canal restoration to be expedited to curb waterlogging in Kochi
content: Mullassery Canal restoration to resume on September 1 and be completed by March; inspections against banned single-use plastic to be intensified; authorities order urgent drain cleaning, relocation of shops over drains and faster measures to address waterlogging across the city

title: Cabinet Secretary, Home Secretary get one-year extension in service
content: The Appointments Committee of the Cabinet led by Prime Minister Modi approved the extension in service of  Somanathan as Cabinet Secretary for a further period of one year beyond August 30, 2026, says an order

title: UDF facilitating Sangh agenda in universities, says Pinarayi
content: He says UDF government is facilitating the Sangh Parivar’s agenda in Kerala’s higher education sector by remaining silent on the Governor’s interventions in universities and abandoning the resistance mounted by the previous LDF government

title: Kerala rain 2026: Rain eases in Thrissur, relief camps continue
content: Five relief camps shelter 59 people; Poringalkuthu dam maintains crest level discharge while three families near Puthur Zoological Park are shifted over landslip risk

title: Include CBSE-sector representatives on panels for readying education policies: council
content: Council of CBSE Schools Kerala visits Chief Minister, Ministers and recommend establishment of a permanent coordination and communication mechanism between the State’s General Education department and CBSE schools

title: RBI has funds to pay for UPI platform without having to charge merchants, customers
content: The government has introduced a Bill in Parliament that will allow it to notify the kinds of transactions that can attract such a charge. So far, UPI has been free for merchants and customers

title: Widespread street protests by NC, PDP mark 7th anniversary of abrogation of Article 370 in J&K
content: J&K Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha distributed appointment letters among family members of terror victims, and termed the abrogation “a historic turning point”

title: ARISE hubs to come up in high schools in Kerala: Minister
content: AI & Robotics Initiative for School Education hubs are intended to expand the possibilities of AI and robotics in learning and experimentation, says Minister

title: Mullaperiyar dam: Kerala reacts sharply to Tamil Nadu Budget announcement on raising water level
content: Kerala government sticks to its declared stand that a new dam has to be built in Mullaperiyar to replace the existing structure which is 131 years old, Minister says

title: Veeragallu at Neeragunda in Arsikere taluk throws light on Hoysala ruler Vishnuvardhana’s last day
content: Villagers in Neeragunda, in Arsikere taluk, have stumbled upon a centuries-old veeragallu (hero stone) bearing a Kannada inscription that could resolve long-standing confusion over the date of the death of Vishnuvardhana, the celebrated ruler of the Hoysala dynasty

title: Supreme Court cracks down on illegal constructions, warns civic authorities of contempt
content: The court also restrained municipal authorities from issuing directions contrary to its orders, warning that any interference could invite contempt proceedings

title: Majority legislators cannot overrule will of political party: Supreme Court
content: Justice Joymalya Bagchi says the maturity of a democracy is measured by the constancy of political parties and their members to their ideology

title: Parliamentary IT committee to Meta: Apologise for PM video removal or lose safe harbour
content: Safe harbour under the IT Act gives tech firms general immunity for users’ posts; the panel also named Google India, seeking similar action against the tech firm for financial frauds

title: AIIMS for Kinalur in Kozhikode: more organisations jump on the bandwagon
content: Communist Party of India to organise protest demonstration on Thursday; Calicut Chamber of Commerce and Industry says avoiding Kinalur is akin to neglecting Malabar’s developmental aspirations

title: Centre deploys national joint response team to support States facing a Chandipura virus outbreak
content: Disease control, medical, animal husbandry experts sent to Gujarat, Rajasthan to support public health measures; sandflies are established vectors, but scientists studying role of other insects, domestic animals too

title: Ongole SP urges public to safeguard newly-planted saplings
content: Launching a tree plantation drive, Harshavardhan Raju cautions the public to consciously reduce the usage of automobile fuel by curtailing unnecessary travel and to totally shun the use of one-time plastic

title: PM, Rajnath hail transformation J&K, Ladakh since Article 370 abrogation
content: In a post on X, the Prime Minister says infrastructure has expanded while opportunities in education, healthcare, entrepreneurship and sports have grown significantly in Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh

title: Tamil Nadu Budget: TVK government merely changed the name of DMK’s schemes, alleges Udhayanidhi
content: Chief Minister’s pre-Budget meeting with officials had been convened solely to rename schemes launched by the erstwhile Dravidian Model government, says DMK leader

title: Police modernisation scheme awaits Finance Ministry’s nod, Centre tells SC
content: The top court had initiated a suo motu proceedings over non-functional CCTV cameras in police stations linked to a spike in custodial deaths in recent months

title: Sexual abuse and murder of child in Palakkad: prime accused held in Tamil Nadu after years on the run
content: Suresh, alias Rahim, 32, is the prime accused in the sexual assault and murder of a four-year-old girl near Palakkad railway station in 2019

title: Two women in flood-hit Polavaram dist. give birth to two girl babies
content: As many as 149 pregnant women were shifted to nearby government hospitals since August 1 due to Sabari and Godavari floods.

title: Govt. is open to talks, Jharkhand CM tells protesting students
content: Hundreds of students have gathered at a stadium in Ranchi to demand a CBI inquiry into alleged irregularities in competitive exams; the protesters have also called for the cancellation of the Preliminary Test of the 14th JPSC Civil Services Examination, and a review of exams conducted through agencies

title: Bomb Attack At Shakib Al Hasan's House Hours After Sheikh Hasina's Delhi Presser
content: The attack took place around 8.45 pm local time at Shakib Al Hasan's ancestral residence in the Keshabmor area of Magura town. The house was also vandalised.

title: New Nuclear Plan As US Updates War Strategy Against China Or Russia: Report
content: Instead of depending mainly on long-range nuclear missiles, the new approach would place greater focus on shorter-range tactical nuclear weapons that could be used in regional conflicts involving US allies.

title: Gujarat Bans Analogue Paneer, Cheese, Butter To Protect Public Health
content: The decision follows extensive sampling and laboratory testing conducted by the Food and Drug Control Administration across Gujarat

title: E20 Petrol Is Cleaner, But Moisture May Be A Concern For Older Cars
content: The E20-compliant vehicles handle the fuel well and result in an efficient fuel system. However, a few older vehicle owners still need to be cautious due to the moisture-absorbing nature of ethanol.

title: "Slave Mentality": BJP MP Urges Centre To Rename Roads Linked To 'Invaders'
content: Raising the issue during a Special Mention in the Rajya Sabha, Dinesh Sharma argued that the country had not fully moved beyond its colonial past and continued to carry symbols and practices associated with foreign rule.

title: What Goes Behind Sheikh Hasina's Homecoming? She Responds To NDTV Question
content: Sheikh Hasina was addressing a virtual press conference via an audio call, in what was her first public media interaction since being ousted and fleeing to India on August 5, 2024.

title: "Bangladesh In Grip Of Fear, Rigged Polls Brought BNP To Power": Sheikh Hasina
content: Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on Wednesday said that the South Asian country's situation has worsened over the last two years with people continuing to live in an atmosphere of fear, insecurity and economic distress.

title: No Proposal To Extend Monsoon Session: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju
content: The proposed Bill had earlier failed to pass through the Lok Sabha during the Budget Session in April

title: Fake Crime Branch, Legal Know-How: Bhopal Woman's Extortion Gang Busted
content: Investigators believe this legal facade helped convince victims that the gang had genuine police connections, making them less likely to resist or report the crimes immediately.

title: Air India Turbulence Lasted 5 Minutes, Crew Had Spinal Injuries: Minister
content: Nearly five minutes of severe turbulence injured 17 people on board an Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi, Ram Mohan Naidu said on Wednesday, adding that investigators are analysing the aircraft's flight recorders to establish what happened.

title: How Kashmir Observed 7th Anniversary Of Scrapping Of Article 370
content: BJP was the only party allowed to take out processions to celebrate the abrogation of Article 370 and bifurcation of Jammu and Kashmir into two Union Territories on August 5, 2019.

title: Producer Of Pawan Singh's 'Wanted' Arrested In Rs 78 Lakh Fraud Case
content: The producer of Bhojpuri superstar Pawan Singh's film Wanted has been arrested by the Uttar Pradesh Police from Mumbai in connection with an alleged Rs 78 lakh investment fraud.

content: The report has commission highlighted the roles of several individuals -- including MP Zia-ur-Rehman Barq and Suhel Iqbal (son of MLA Iqbal Mahmood).

content: In the address, while speaking about her father, Sheikh Mujibur Rahman's, assassination during a military coup, she broke down.

content: According to relatives, the four friends were travelling late at night to drop Nitin near Chirawa when the accident occurred.

title: Speeding Tempo Collides Head-On With Ambulance On Yamuna Expressway, 2 Dead
content: According to police, the speeding loader tempo collided head-on with an ambulance, leaving both occupants of the loader critically injured.

content: The ceremony was held at a Shiva temple in Asrafpur village on Tuesday in the presence of other villagers.

content: The NHAI has also initiated action against concessionaire PNC Infratech Limited, the project's Independent Engineer and officials responsible for construction monitoring and supervision.

content: In this "black widow" scam, vulnerable men are persuaded into sham marriages just before deployment. If they are killed, their new wives legally receive the compensation, leaving parents, children or siblings with nothing.
